error[ZBX-E0807]: the image can't be made as declared
  cause  'zbx.build.zon' line 4, column 38: image.config .user "a b" is not a
         name, a number, or user:group of those
  fix    write .user as a name or a number, or as "user:group", for example
         "app:app" or "0:0"
  more   zbx explain E0807 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0807.html
